page.overview:
What is Vaporeon?

Vaporeon shares physical traits with aquatic animals and felids in appearance. Its overall body shape has small cat-like features, such as little paws and feet, a round head, a blunt, short muzzle, and a small triangular nose. Most of its body is light-blue, with a white, finned ruff around its neck; it has cream-yellowish ear-like fins on both sides of its head, along with a third fin-like appendage on the top of its forehead. It has dark blue ridges that run down the length of its head, spine, and along its tail-fin. Its long tail resembles that of a dolphin, whale, or mermaid.

A Shiny Vaporeon is mostly light purple in color while its ridges are a darker shade of purple. Its ear-like fins and ruff remain the same.

Vaporeon's molecular structure is close to water, and its body glitters when sunlight hits at certain angles because of this nature. It has a slender, feline body shape all around, further adapting the Pokémon to aquatic regions so it could swim faster. Vaporeon is the result of an Eevee's exposure to the radiation of a Water Stone.

Vaporeon prefer clean freshwater lakes. They have developed gills to become better suited to an aquatic lifestyle, and their cell composition's similarity to water allows them to melt into the water, which they use the ability to hunt and sneak up on its prey. They themselves also love to swim. It is also known as a calm, but docile Pokémon. As with every other Eeveelution, they're highly rare in the wild and are usually seen in urban areas under the ownership of Trainers.
